## data process
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)
library(viridis)
mobility <- read.csv("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/uconn health paper1/processed_mobility.csv")
mobility$DIST <- gsub("\\.", "-", mobility$DIST)
agg <- read.csv("/Users/huzeyu/Desktop/uconn health paper1/processd_expenditure2019_2023.csv")
# 使用merge函数合并数据
merged_data <- merge(agg, mobility, by = c("DIST", "YEARMONTHWEEK"))
# 添加新列 YEAR，其值是 YEARMONTHWEEK 列的前四位
merged_data$YEAR <- substr(merged_data$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4)
merged_data$MONTH <- substr(merged_data$YEARMONTHWEEK, 6, 7)
merged_data$YEARMONTH <- substr(merged_data$YEARMONTHWEEK,1,7)
merged_data <- subset(merged_data, YEARMONTHWEEK != "2023")
data2019 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2019")
data2019$EXPENDITURE <- data2019$EXPENDITURE/1644460
data2020 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2020")
data2020$EXPENDITURE <- data2020$EXPENDITURE/1697050
data2021 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2021")
data2021$EXPENDITURE <- data2021$EXPENDITURE/1609040
data2022 <- subset(merged_data, YEAR == "2022")
data2022$EXPENDITURE <- data2022$EXPENDITURE/1669400

USDdata <- rbind(data2019,data2020,data2021,data2022)##thousand dollars
```

## diff data process
```{r include=FALSE}
data2019 <- data2019 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2019 <- data2019 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
data2020 <- data2020 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2020 <- data2020 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
data2021 <- data2021 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2021 <- data2021 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
data2022 <- data2022 %>% mutate(Week_Number = as.integer(as.factor(YEARMONTHWEEK)))
data2022 <- data2022 %>% mutate(DIST_week = paste(DIST, Week_Number,BIZ, sep = "-"))
#19 20
combined1920 <- inner_join(data2020, data2019, by = "DIST_week", suffix = c("_2020", "_2019"))
diff_data2020 <- combined1920 %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE = EXPENDITURE_2020 - EXPENDITURE_2019,
    mobility = mobility_2020 - mobility_2019,
    EXPENDITURE_Pchange = 100*(EXPENDITURE_2020 - EXPENDITURE_2019)/EXPENDITURE_2019
  ) %>%
  select(YEARMONTHWEEK_2020, BIZ_2020,DIST_2020,YEAR_2020, EXPENDITURE, mobility,MONTH_2020,EXPENDITURE_Pchange) %>%
  rename(
    YEARMONTHWEEK = YEARMONTHWEEK_2020,
    BIZ = BIZ_2020,
    DIST = DIST_2020,
    YEAR = YEAR_2020,
    MONTH = MONTH_2020,
    expPchange = EXPENDITURE_Pchange
  )

#19 21
combined1921 <- inner_join(data2021, data2019, by = "DIST_week", suffix = c("_2021", "_2019"))
diff_data2021 <- combined1921 %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE = EXPENDITURE_2021 - EXPENDITURE_2019,
    mobility = mobility_2021 - mobility_2019,
    EXPENDITURE_Pchange = 100*(EXPENDITURE_2021 - EXPENDITURE_2019)/EXPENDITURE_2019
  ) %>%
  select(YEARMONTHWEEK_2021, BIZ_2021,DIST_2021,YEAR_2021, EXPENDITURE, mobility,MONTH_2021,EXPENDITURE_Pchange) %>%
  rename(
    YEARMONTHWEEK = YEARMONTHWEEK_2021,
    BIZ = BIZ_2021,
    DIST = DIST_2021,
    YEAR = YEAR_2021,
    MONTH = MONTH_2021,
    expPchange = EXPENDITURE_Pchange
  )

#19 22
combined1922 <- inner_join(data2022, data2019, by = "DIST_week", suffix = c("_2022", "_2019"))
diff_data2022 <- combined1922 %>%
  mutate(
    EXPENDITURE = EXPENDITURE_2022 - EXPENDITURE_2019,
    mobility = mobility_2022 - mobility_2019,
    EXPENDITURE_Pchange = 100*(EXPENDITURE_2022 - EXPENDITURE_2019)/EXPENDITURE_2019
  ) %>%
  select(YEARMONTHWEEK_2022, BIZ_2022,DIST_2022,YEAR_2022, EXPENDITURE, mobility,MONTH_2022,EXPENDITURE_Pchange) %>%
  rename(
    YEARMONTHWEEK = YEARMONTHWEEK_2022,
    BIZ = BIZ_2022,
    DIST = DIST_2022,
    YEAR = YEAR_2022,
    MONTH = MONTH_2022,
    expPchange = EXPENDITURE_Pchange
  )

USDdatadiff <- rbind(diff_data2020,diff_data2021,diff_data2022)
USDdatadiff$YEARMONTH <-  paste0(USDdatadiff$YEAR, "-", USDdatadiff$MONTH)
##USDdatadiffSeoul doesn't have districts column
USDdatadiffSeoul <- USDdatadiff %>%
  group_by(YEARMONTHWEEK, BIZ) %>%
  summarise(EXPENDITURE = sum(EXPENDITURE),
            mobility = sum(mobility))
USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTH <- substr(USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTHWEEK,1,7)
USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTH <- gsub("-","",USDdatadiffSeoul$YEARMONTH)
```

## barplot data process
```{r include=FALSE}
aggregate_data <- USDdata %>%
  group_by(BIZ, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(overallexp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
            overallmobility = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 定义一个函数来针对特定地区分组求和
summarize_by_group <- function(data, districts) {
  data %>%
    filter(DIST %in% districts) %>%
    group_by(BIZ, YEAR) %>%
    summarise(exp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
              mobility = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

# 计算每个特定地区条件的总和
commercial_data <- summarize_by_group(USDdata, commercial_districts)
noncommercial_data <- summarize_by_group(USDdata, noncommercial_districts)

# 合并所有数据
barplotdata <- aggregate_data %>%
  left_join(commercial_data, by = c("BIZ", "YEAR")) %>%
  left_join(noncommercial_data, by = c("BIZ", "YEAR"))
barplotdata <- barplotdata %>%
  mutate(BIZ = case_when(
    BIZ == "restaurant" ~ "restaurant",
    BIZ == "entertainment" ~ "entertainment",
    BIZ == "clothing" ~ "clothing",
    BIZ == "medical" ~ "medical",
    BIZ == "education" ~ "education",
    BIZ == "shopping" ~ "shopping",
    BIZ == "homelife" ~ "home appliances",
    BIZ == "travel" ~ "travel"
  ))
restaurant_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="restaurant")
entertainment_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="entertainment")
medical_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="medical")
clothing_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="clothing")
travel_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="travel")
education_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="education")
shopping_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="shopping")
homelife_data <- subset(barplotdata, BIZ =="home appliances")
```

## PPT overall trend of excess expenditure and mobility(PPT #7)
```{r echo=FALSE}
all_diff_Seoul <- USDdatadiffSeoul %>%
  group_by(YEARMONTHWEEK) %>%
  summarise(diffexp = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
            diffmobility = (sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE))/8) %>%
  ungroup() 
all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTH <- substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK,1,7)
scale_all <- max(abs(all_diff_Seoul$diffmobility))/max(abs(all_diff_Seoul$diffexp))
all_diff_Seoul <- all_diff_Seoul %>%
  group_by(YEARMONTH) %>%
  mutate(x_label = if_else(row_number() == 1, as.character(YEARMONTH), "")) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(all_diff_Seoul, aes(x = YEARMONTHWEEK)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = diffmobility/scale_all, group = 1, colour = "Mobility difference"),size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = diffexp, group = 1, colour = "Expenditure difference"),size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual("", 
                      breaks = c("Mobility difference", "Expenditure difference"),
                      values = c("red", "green")) +
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Expenditure difference(in USD $000)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . *scale_all/1000, name = "Mobility diff(*1000)")) + 
  labs(title = "Difference in Mobility and all Expenditure based on 2019 over the next 3 years",
       x = "YEARMONTHWEEK") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = all_diff_Seoul$x_label)+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1,size=7))+
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2020-02-02"), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2020-02-02"), y = 0, label = "Introduction of COVID-19\nwith social distancing policy", angle = 0, hjust = 0.3, vjust = -8, size = 3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2021-03-01"), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2021-03-01"), y = 0, label = "Introduction of vaccination", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -25, size = 3)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2022-02-01"), color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2022-02-01"), y = 0, label = "Relaxing of social distancing policy", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -25, size = 3)+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1.4) + 
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Default text size and style for the entire plot
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Title
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Axis titles
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), # Axis text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), # Legend title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) + # Legend text
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))

ggplot(all_diff_Seoul, aes(x = YEARMONTHWEEK)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = diffmobility/scale_all, group = 1, colour = "Mobility difference"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = diffexp, group = 1, colour = "Expenditure difference"), size = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual("", 
                      breaks = c("Mobility difference", "Expenditure difference"),
                      values = c("black", "blue")) +  # Use black and blue for the lines
  theme_minimal() + 
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Expenditure difference(in USD $000)",
                     sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . *scale_all/1000, name = "Mobility diff(*1000)")) + 
  labs(title = "Difference in Mobility and all Expenditure based on 2019 over the next 3 years",
       x = "YEARMONTHWEEK") + 
  scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL) +  # Remove original x-axis labels
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, size = 7)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2020-02-02"), color = "black") + 
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2020-02-02"), y = 0, label = "Introduction of COVID-19\nwith social distancing policy", angle = 0, hjust = 0.3, vjust = -8, size = 3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2021-03-01"), color = "black") + 
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2021-03-01"), y = 0, label = "Introduction of vaccination", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -25, size = 3) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2022-02-01"), color = "black") + 
  annotate("text", x = which(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK == "2022-02-01"), y = 0, label = "Relaxing of social distancing policy", angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = -25, size = 3) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1.4) +

  annotate("segment", x = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1], 
           xend = which(substr(all_diff_Seoul$YEARMONTHWEEK, 1, 4) == "2020")[1],
```

## PPT expenditure by business sectors(overall districts talk with prof.Jo to decide save or not) KEEP it
```{r echo=FALSE}
# 定义颜色向量
custom_colors <- c(
  "travel" = "lightblue",
  "restaurant" = "red",          
  "shopping" = "lightgrey",
  "medical" = "yellow",          
  "clothing" = "blue",
  "entertainment" = "green",
  "education" = "orange",
  "home appliances" = "purple"
)
barplotdata$BIZ <- factor(barplotdata$BIZ, levels = c("travel", "restaurant", "shopping", "medical", "clothing", "entertainment", "education", "home appliances"))

# 使用scale_fill_manual来自定义特定因素级别的颜色
ggplot(barplotdata, aes(x = YEAR, y = overallexp/1000, fill = BIZ)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(), width = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~BIZ, scales = 'fixed', ncol = 8) +
  labs(title = "Overall expenditure by Years and Business sectors",
       y = "Expenditure in $000") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Default text size and style for the entire plot
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Title
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Axis titles
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), # Axis text
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), # Legend title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) + # Legend text
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```

## PPT daytime~district barplot(#13)
```{r echo=FALSE}
daytimedata <- district_info[,c(1,3)]
daytimedata <- daytimedata %>%
  mutate(label= if_else(DIST %in% commercial_districts,
                        "commercial districts",
                        "non-commercial districts"))


# 为了使条形图按Daytime_pop_percent的值排序，首先需要将DIST转换为因子，并按Daytime_pop_percent排序
daytimedata$DIST <- factor(daytimedata$DIST, levels = daytimedata$DIST[order(daytimedata$Daytime_pop_percent, decreasing = TRUE)])

# 使用scale_fill_manual来自定义颜色
ggplot(daytimedata, aes(x = DIST, y = Daytime_pop_percent, fill = label)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("commercial districts" = "darkblue", 
                               "non-commercial districts" = "grey")) +
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x = "District",
       y = "Daytime population index") +
```

## models for restaurant
```{r echo=FALSE}
yearly_sums <- list()

# 循环处理2019年到2022年的数据
for(year in 2019:2022) {
  yearly_data <- USDdata %>%
    filter(YEAR == year, BIZ == "restaurant") %>%
    group_by(DIST) %>%
    summarise(`sumexp` = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE)) 
  
  # 为汇总列直接添加年份后缀，不使用rename
  colname <- paste0(year, "sumexp")
  names(yearly_data)[2] <- colname
  
  # 将每年的结果存储在list中
  yearly_sums[[as.character(year)]] <- yearly_data
}

# 得到2019-2022 sum exp
sumexp_restaurant <- reduce(yearly_sums, full_join, by = "DIST")

# 初始化一个空的数据框架来存储所有年份的结果
all_years_coefficients <- list()

# 遍历2019年到2022年
for(year in 2019:2022) {
  # 筛选出当前年份的餐厅数据
  data_year_restaurant <- subset(USDdata, BIZ == "restaurant" & YEAR == as.character(year))
  # 初始化当前年份的结果数据框
  coefficients_restaurant_year <- data.frame(DIST = character(), slope = numeric(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  unique_dists <- unique(data_year_restaurant$DIST)
  for(dist in unique_dists) {
    # Subset data for the current DIST
    subset_data <- data_year_restaurant[data_year_restaurant$DIST == dist, ]
    
    # 标准化expenditure和mobility
    subset_data$EXPENDITURE <- scale(subset_data$EXPENDITURE)
    subset_data$mobility <- scale(subset_data$mobility)
    
    # Build the linear model with standardized variables
    model <- lm(EXPENDITURE ~ mobility + YEARMONTH, data = subset_data) 
    
    # Extract the slope coefficient for 'mobility'
    slope <- coef(model)["mobility"]
    
    # Append the DIST and corresponding slope to the results dataframe
    coefficients_restaurant_year <- rbind(coefficients_restaurant_year, data.frame(DIST = dist, slope = slope))
  }
  
  # 将当前年份的结果存储在列表中
  all_years_coefficients[[as.character(year)]] <- coefficients_restaurant_year
}



# 首先为每个数据框的斜率列添加年份后缀
names_list <- c("2019", "2020", "2021", "2022") # 年份列表
for(year in names_list) {
  # 修改斜率列的名称，添加年份后缀
  names(all_years_coefficients[[year]])[2] <- paste0("slope", year)
}

# 使用Reduce和merge按DIST合并所有数据框
coefficients_restaurant <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "DIST", all = TRUE), all_years_coefficients)

# 内连接
restaurant_slope_characteristic <- coefficients_restaurant %>%
  left_join(sumexp_restaurant, by = "DIST") %>%
  left_join(district_info, by = "DIST")

long_df_restaurant <- pivot_longer(restaurant_slope_characteristic,
                                   cols = starts_with("slope"),
                                   names_to = "Year",
                                   values_to = "Slope")
```

## PPT boxplot(#16/17)
```{r echo=FALSE}
coefficients_restaurant$category <- 'restaurant'
coefficients_entertainment$category <- 'entertainment'
coefficients_clothing$category <- 'clothing'
coefficients_medical$category <- 'medical'
coefficients_travel$category <- 'travel'
coefficients_education$category <- 'education'
coefficients_shopping$category <- 'shopping'
coefficients_homelife$category <- 'home appliances'
newdata <- bind_rows(coefficients_restaurant, coefficients_entertainment,coefficients_clothing,
                     coefficients_medical, coefficients_travel, coefficients_education,
                     coefficients_shopping, coefficients_homelife)

newdata <- newdata %>% 
  gather(key = "year", value = "slope", slope2019, slope2020, slope2021, slope2022) %>% 
  mutate(year = sub("slope", "", year)) # 移除 'slope' 文字，只保留年份
newdata_commercial <- newdata %>% filter(DIST %in% commercial_districts)
newdata_noncommercial <- newdata %>% filter(DIST %in% noncommercial_districts)
newdata_commercial$category <- factor(newdata_commercial$category, levels = c("travel", "restaurant", "shopping", "medical", "clothing", "entertainment", "education", "home appliances"))
ggplot(newdata_commercial, aes(x = year, y = slope, fill = category)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~category, scales = 'fixed', ncol = 8) +  # 使用DIST变量创建分面，并允许每个分面有自己的y轴范围
  #theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Elasticity by year and business sectors in commercial districts", 
       x = "Year", 
       y = "slope: consumption elasticity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red",linetype = "dashed", size = 1.3)+
  ylim(-1,1.5)+
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Default text size and style for the entire plot
        plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # Title
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"), # Axis titles

        legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"), # Legend title
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")) + # Legend text
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1))
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
data_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(restaurant_slope_characteristic, cols = starts_with("slope"),
                                 names_to = "Year", values_to = "Slope")

# 将年份转换为一个因子，以便在图例中以不同颜色显示
data_long$Year <- factor(data_long$Year, levels = c("slope2019", "slope2020", "slope2021", "slope2022"))

# 绘制散点图
ggplot(data_long, aes(x = Daytime_pop_percent, y = Slope, color = Year, shape = as.factor(DIST))) +
  geom_point() + 
  scale_shape_manual(values = 1:25) + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Daytime Population Percent", y = "Restaurant Slope", color = "Year", shape = "DIST") + # 自定义标签
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"), # 默认字体大小和样式
```

## heat map for expenditure
```{r echo=FALSE}
USDdata1 <- USDdata %>%
  mutate(BIZ = case_when(
    BIZ == "restaurant" ~ "restaurant",
    BIZ == "entertainment" ~ "entertainment",
    BIZ == "clothing" ~ "clothing",
    BIZ == "medical" ~ "medical",
    BIZ == "education" ~ "education",
    BIZ == "shopping" ~ "shopping",
    BIZ == "homelife" ~ "home appliances",
    BIZ == "travel" ~ "travel"
  ))
commercial_exp <- aggregate(EXPENDITURE ~ BIZ + YEAR, data = USDdata1[USDdata1$DIST %in% commercial_districts, ], FUN = sum)
commercial_exp_2019 <- subset(commercial_exp, YEAR == 2019, select = c(BIZ, EXPENDITURE))

# 设置BIZ作为行名，方便后续计算
row.names(commercial_exp_2019) <- commercial_exp_2019$BIZ

# 创建一个新的数据框来存储变化率
commercial_heat_data <- data.frame(BIZ = unique(commercial_exp$BIZ))

# 对每个BIZ计算2020, 2021, 和 2022年的变化率
for(year in c(2020, 2021, 2022)) {
  # 计算每个BIZ在当前年份的EXPENDITURE
  commercial_exp_current_year <- subset(commercial_exp, YEAR == year, select = c(BIZ, EXPENDITURE))
  
  # 计算变化率
  change_rates <- (commercial_exp_current_year$EXPENDITURE - commercial_exp_2019[commercial_exp_current_year$BIZ, "EXPENDITURE"]) / 
    commercial_exp_2019[commercial_exp_current_year$BIZ, "EXPENDITURE"]
  
  commercial_heat_data <- cbind(commercial_heat_data, setNames(data.frame(change_rates), as.character(year)))
}

commercial_long_data <- melt(commercial_heat_data, id.vars = "BIZ", variable.name = "YEAR", value.name = "PERCENT_CHANGE")

commercial_long_data$PERCENT_CHANGE <- commercial_long_data$PERCENT_CHANGE * 100
commercial_long_data$BIZ <- factor(commercial_long_data$BIZ, levels = rev(unique(commercial_long_data$BIZ)))

# 绘制热图
ggplot(commercial_long_data, aes(x = YEAR, y = BIZ, fill = PERCENT_CHANGE)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", midpoint = 0, limit = c(-50, 50), name = "Change (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Yearly Percent Change of Expenditure in commercial districts") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", PERCENT_CHANGE)), size = 3)

noncommercial_exp <- aggregate(EXPENDITURE ~ BIZ + YEAR, data = USDdata1[USDdata1$DIST %in% noncommercial_districts, ], FUN = sum)
noncommercial_exp_2019 <- subset(noncommercial_exp, YEAR == 2019, select = c(BIZ, EXPENDITURE))

# 设置BIZ作为行名，方便后续计算
row.names(noncommercial_exp_2019) <- noncommercial_exp_2019$BIZ

# 创建一个新的数据框来存储变化率
noncommercial_heat_data <- data.frame(BIZ = unique(noncommercial_exp$BIZ))

# 对每个BIZ计算2020, 2021, 和 2022年的变化率
for(year in c(2020, 2021, 2022)) {
  # 计算每个BIZ在当前年份的EXPENDITURE
  noncommercial_exp_current_year <- subset(noncommercial_exp, YEAR == year, select = c(BIZ, EXPENDITURE))
  
  # 计算变化率
  change_rates <- (noncommercial_exp_current_year$EXPENDITURE - noncommercial_exp_2019[noncommercial_exp_current_year$BIZ, "EXPENDITURE"]) / 
    noncommercial_exp_2019[noncommercial_exp_current_year$BIZ, "EXPENDITURE"]
  
  noncommercial_heat_data <- cbind(noncommercial_heat_data, setNames(data.frame(change_rates), as.character(year)))
}

noncommercial_long_data <- melt(noncommercial_heat_data, id.vars = "BIZ", variable.name = "YEAR", value.name = "PERCENT_CHANGE")

noncommercial_long_data$PERCENT_CHANGE <- noncommercial_long_data$PERCENT_CHANGE * 100

noncommercial_long_data$BIZ <- factor(noncommercial_long_data$BIZ, levels = rev(unique(noncommercial_long_data$BIZ)))

# 绘制热图
ggplot(noncommercial_long_data, aes(x = YEAR, y = BIZ, fill = PERCENT_CHANGE)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", midpoint = 0, limit = c(-50, 50), name = "Change (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Yearly Percent Change of Expenditure in non-commercial districts") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", PERCENT_CHANGE)), size = 3)
```

## heat map for districts
```{r echo=FALSE}
summary_mobility <- aggregate(mobility ~ DIST + YEAR, data = USDdata1, FUN = sum)
summary_mobility <- summary_mobility %>%
  bind_rows(summary_mobility %>%
              group_by(YEAR) %>%
              summarise(mobility = sum(mobility), .groups = 'drop') %>%
              mutate(DIST = "all"))
mobility_heat_data <- summary_mobility %>%
  group_by(DIST) %>%
  spread(key = YEAR, value = mobility) %>%  # 将YEAR列的不同值转换为不同列
  mutate(`2020` = (`2020` - `2019`)/`2019` * 100,
         `2021` = (`2021` - `2019`)/`2019` * 100,
         `2022` = (`2022` - `2019`)/`2019` * 100) %>%
  select(DIST, `2020`, `2021`, `2022`)  # 选择需要的列

# 首先将info中的daytime_index合并到mobility_heat_data中
mobility_heat_data <- left_join(mobility_heat_data, district_info[, c("DIST", "Daytime_pop_percent")], by = "DIST")

# 计算除'all'外其他地区daytime_index的总和
totaldaytime <- sum(mobility_heat_data$Daytime_pop_percent[mobility_heat_data$DIST != "all"], na.rm = TRUE)

# 然后将这个总和值分配给'DIST'为'all'的行
mobility_heat_data <- mobility_heat_data %>%
  mutate(Daytime_pop_percent = if_else(DIST == "all", totaldaytime, Daytime_pop_percent))

# 数据预处理：按Daytime_pop_percent对BIZ排序
mobility_heat_data <- mobility_heat_data %>%
  arrange(desc(Daytime_pop_percent))

# 将数据从宽格式转换为长格式
mobility_heat_data_long <- mobility_heat_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("2020", "2021", "2022"), names_to = "Year", values_to = "PercentageChange")

mobility_heat_data_long$DIST <- factor(mobility_heat_data_long$DIST, levels = unique(mobility_heat_data_long$DIST))

my_colors <- viridis(256, option = "C", begin = 0.3, end = 0.9)

ggplot(mobility_heat_data_long, aes(x = Year, y = DIST, fill = PercentageChange)) +
  geom_tile() +  # 使用瓦片图层
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", PercentageChange)), color = "black", size = 3) +  # 添加数值标签
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = my_colors, limits = c(-30, 30), name="Percentage Change (%)", space = "Lab") +
  labs(title = "Yearly Mobility Change (%) by District", x = "Year", y = "District") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) 
```

## DD 数据处理
```{r include=FALSE}
## Diff-Diff
commercial_districts <- c ("Jung-gu", "Jongno-gu", "Gangnam-gu")
noncommercial_districts <- c( "Gangdong-gu", "Gangbuk-gu", "Gangseo-gu", "Gwanak-gu", "Gwangjin-gu",
                              "Guro-gu", "Geumcheon-gu", "Nowon-gu", "Dobong-gu", "Dongdaemun-gu", "Dongjak-gu", 
                              "Mapo-gu", "Seodaemun-gu", "Seocho-gu", "Seongdong-gu", "Seongbuk-gu", "Songpa-gu", 
                              "Yangcheon-gu", "Yeongdeungpo-gu", "Yongsan-gu", "Eunpyeong-gu", 
                              "Jungnang-gu")
DDdata <- USDdata %>%
  group_by(YEAR, DIST) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mobility = mean(mobility), 
    mean_expenditure = mean(EXPENDITURE) 
  )
DDdata <- DDdata %>%
  mutate(
    DIST_TYPE = ifelse(DIST %in% commercial_districts, "Commercial District", 
                       ifelse(DIST %in% noncommercial_districts, "Non-commercial District", NA))
  )

# 计算每年每种区域类型的mobility和expenditure均值
地区data <- DDdata %>%
  filter(!is.na(DIST_TYPE)) %>% 
  group_by(YEAR, DIST_TYPE) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mobility = mean(mean_mobility, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_expenditure = mean(mean_expenditure, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop' 
  ) %>%
  rename(DIST = DIST_TYPE)
```

## ddplot mobility
```{r include=FALSE}
subset_data1 <- 地区data %>%
  filter(DIST == "Non-commercial District" & (YEAR == 2019 | YEAR == 2020))
control_slope1 <- lm(mean_mobility ~ as.numeric(YEAR), 
                     data = subset_data1)$coefficients['as.numeric(YEAR)']
treatment_data1 <- 地区data %>%
  filter(DIST == "Commercial District" & (YEAR == 2019 | YEAR == 2020)) %>%
  mutate(projected_mobility = (as.numeric(YEAR) - as.numeric(min(YEAR))) * control_slope1 + first(mean_mobility))

subset_data2 <- 地区data %>%
  filter(DIST == "Non-commercial District" & (YEAR == 2020 | YEAR == 2021))
control_slope2 <- lm(mean_mobility ~ as.numeric(YEAR),

  filter(DIST == "Commercial District" & (YEAR == 2020 | YEAR == 2021)) %>%
  mutate(projected_mobility = (as.numeric(YEAR) - as.numeric(min(YEAR))) * control_slope2 + first(mean_mobility))

ggplot(地区data, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = mean_mobility/1000, color = DIST)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = DIST), size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = treatment_data1, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = projected_mobility/1000, group = DIST), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = treatment_data2, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = projected_mobility/1000, group = DIST), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = treatment_data3, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = projected_mobility/1000, group = DIST), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Commercial District" = "darkblue", "Non-commercial District" = "grey")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean mobility (in thousand)", color = "District Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size=20, face="bold") # 设置字体大小和加粗
  ) +
```

```{r include=FALSE}
treatment_data2 <- 地区data %>%
  filter(DIST == "Commercial District" & (YEAR == 2020 | YEAR == 2021)) %>%
  mutate(projected_expenditure = (as.numeric(YEAR) - as.numeric(min(YEAR))) * control_slope2 + first(mean_expenditure))

subset_data3 <- 地区data %>%
  filter(DIST == "Non-commercial District" & (YEAR == 2022 | YEAR == 2021))
control_slope3 <- lm(mean_expenditure ~ as.numeric(YEAR), 
                     data = subset_data3)$coefficients['as.numeric(YEAR)']
treatment_data3 <- 地区data %>%
  filter(DIST == "Commercial District" & (YEAR == 2021 | YEAR == 2022)) %>%
  mutate(projected_expenditure = (as.numeric(YEAR) - as.numeric(min(YEAR))) * control_slope3 + first(mean_expenditure))

# Create the plot with the projected line
ggplot(地区data, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = mean_expenditure, color = DIST)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = DIST), size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line(data = treatment_data1, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = projected_expenditure, group = DIST), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = treatment_data2, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = projected_expenditure, group = DIST), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = treatment_data3, aes(x = as.factor(YEAR), y = projected_expenditure, group = DIST), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Commercial District" = "darkblue", "Non-commercial District" = "grey")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean expenditure (in thousand)", color = "District Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    text = element_text(size=20, face="bold") # 设置字体大小和加粗
  ) +
  ggtitle("Mean expenditure by District Type over Years")

```

##sankey
```{r echo=FALSE}
newdataall <- rbind(newdata2020,newdata2021,newdata2022)
library(networkD3)
# 创建分类映射
area_mapping <- c(
  "Jongno-gu"="Jongno & Jung", "Jung-gu"="Jongno & Jung",
  "Gangnam-gu"="Gangnam",
  "Dobong-gu"="non-Comm. Area North", "Dongdaemun-gu"="non-Comm. Area North",
  "Eunpyeong-gu"="non-Comm. Area North", "Gangbuk-gu"="non-Comm. Area North",
  "Gwangjin-gu"="non-Comm. Area North", "Jungnang-gu"="non-Comm. Area North",
  "Mapo-gu"="non-Comm. Area North", "Nowon-gu"="non-Comm. Area North",
  "Seodaemun-gu"="non-Comm. Area North", "Seongbuk-gu"="non-Comm. Area North",
  "Seongdong-gu"="non-Comm. Area North", "Yongsan-gu"="non-Comm. Area North",
  "Gangdong-gu"="non-Comm. Area South", "Gangseo-gu"="non-Comm. Area South",
  "Gwanak-gu"="non-Comm. Area South", "Guro-gu"="non-Comm. Area South",
  "Geumcheon-gu"="non-Comm. Area South", "Dongjak-gu"="non-Comm. Area South",
  "Seocho-gu"="non-Comm. Area South", "Songpa-gu"="non-Comm. Area South",
  "Yangcheon-gu"="non-Comm. Area South", "Yeongdeungpo-gu"="non-Comm. Area South",
  "Outside Seoul"="Outside Seoul"
)

# 应用映射到数据框
newdataall <- newdataall %>%
  mutate(
    origin_gu = area_mapping[origin_gu],
    destination_gu = area_mapping[destination_gu]
  )
sankeydata <- newdataall %>%
  group_by(origin_gu,destination_gu,YEAR) %>%
  summarise(total_sum = sum(total_sum),.groups = 'drop')
unique(sankeydata$origin_gu)
gu_names <- unique(c(sankeydata$origin_gu, sankeydata$destination_gu))
nodes <- data.frame(name = c(gu_names, gu_names, gu_names, gu_names))

# 创建链接
# 链接需要有 source（起点）、target（终点）和 value（值）三个列
links <- list()
for (year in unique(sankeydata$YEAR)) {
  year_data <- subset(sankeydata, YEAR == year)
  offset <- (year - 2020) * 5
  year_links <- with(year_data, data.frame(
    source = match(origin_gu, gu_names) - 1 + offset,
    target = match(destination_gu, gu_names) - 1 + 5 + offset,
    value = total_sum
  ))
  links <- rbind(links, year_links)
}

# 创建 Sankey 图
sankey <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = links,
  Nodes = nodes,
  Source = "source",
  Target = "target",
  Value = "value",
  NodeID = "name",
  units = "Total Sum",
  fontSize = 10,
  nodeWidth = 20  # 调整节点宽度
)
print(sankey)

```

## expenditure "%" change barplot in 6 districts:data process(loop)
```{r echo=FALSE}
expenditure_6districts <- USDdata %>% 
  filter(DIST %in% selected_districts) %>%
  mutate(DIST = factor(DIST, levels = selected_districts))

# get all BIZ
biz_types <- unique(expenditure_6districts$BIZ)

for (biz in biz_types) {
  biz_data <- expenditure_6districts %>% filter(BIZ == biz)
  
  summarized_expenditure <- biz_data %>%
    group_by(DIST, YEAR) %>%
    summarise(total_expenditure = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # % change compared to 2019
  percent_change_expenditure <- summarized_expenditure %>%
    group_by(DIST) %>%
    mutate(percent_change = (total_expenditure / total_expenditure[YEAR == 2019] - 1) * 100)
  
  var_name <- paste0("expenditure_", biz, "_6districts")
  assign(var_name, percent_change_expenditure)
}
```

## maps % change data process
```{r echo=FALSE}
change_2019_2020 <- USDdata %>%
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2019, 2020)) %>%
  group_by(DIST, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    total_expenditure = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mobility = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = YEAR, values_from = c(total_expenditure, total_mobility)) %>%
  mutate(
    exp_change_2019_2020 = (total_expenditure_2020 / total_expenditure_2019 - 1) * 100,
    mob_change_2019_2020 = (total_mobility_2020 / total_mobility_2019 - 1) * 100
  )

# 计算每个地区2022年相对于2020年的expenditure和mobility的变化率
change_2020_2022 <- USDdata %>%
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2020, 2022)) %>%
  group_by(DIST, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    total_expenditure = sum(EXPENDITURE, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_mobility = sum(mobility, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = YEAR, values_from = c(total_expenditure, total_mobility)) %>%
  mutate(
    exp_change_2020_2022 = (total_expenditure_2022 / total_expenditure_2020 - 1) * 100,
    mob_change_2020_2022 = (total_mobility_2022 / total_mobility_2020 - 1) * 100
  )

# 合并变化率数据
changes <- change_2019_2020 %>%
  select(DIST, exp_change_2019_2020, mob_change_2019_2020) %>%
  inner_join(change_2020_2022 %>%
               select(DIST, exp_change_2020_2022, mob_change_2020_2022), by = "DIST")
seoul_municipalities <- seoul_municipalities %>%
  inner_join(changes, by = "DIST")
```
